captions.detailed: This object is a pair of image-stabilized binoculars with a dark gray, rubber-armored housing. It consists of two main barrels connected by a central hinge, with cylindrical black lenses at both the front and rear of each barrel. A central focusing knob is mounted on the bridge between the barrels, and a small, greenish-yellow stabilizer activation lever is located on the upper surface of the right barrel housing.
captions.instruction: Generate a 3D model of an image-stabilized binocular. It should feature two main dark gray barrels connected by a central hinge, cylindrical black lenses on both ends, a central focus knob, and a small stabilizer lever on the right barrel body.
captions.factory: Construct two main barrel bodies using lofted or extruded profiles to create the ergonomic rubber-armored shape, then cap them with cylinders for the optical lenses. Create a central bridge with a revolute joint to connect the left and right barrels. Model the central focus knob as a cylinder with a revolute joint along the bridge axis, and construct the stabilizer lever on the right barrel using small box primitives joined by a revolute hinge.
